rounds.defects: People stand with hands clasped instead of acting: s14-a firefighter has no nozzle in hand, s9-a call taker never lifts the phone, s4-a lineworker floats beside the tower head with no shadow; the biggest number is only printed, the s2-a burn scar stays a small blob and the s3-a tiles are faint dashes

The blue solar panel floats detached beside every tower; repeated compositions, tower left with one person standing right facing the lens in s1-a, s5-b, s10-a, s12-a, s14-b, and s13-b draws 68 two-eyed towers when c10 says 68 cameras; the smoke curl reads as grey bubbles and the STINNETT label is navy on the dark scar

The smoke curl, the hook object and throughline, is drawn as a stiff grey diagonal bar that reads as a pole in s1-a, s6-b and s8; long holds make near-identical frame pairs in s2-a, s3-a, s6-a, s13-a and s14-a, with several flat navy infographic cards

Held repeated frames with people posed instead of acting: s1-a, s2-a, s3-a, s5-a, s8-a and s13 show the same still twice, the rancher never kneels at the charred post and the lineworker never bolts the head; the ending does not show its sentence, somebody still has to drive toward the smoke plays over a waving rancher while a black patch floats behind the cropped firefighter

The 1,058,482 acres reads as a printed counter over brick-like tiles in s3 with near-identical paired frames; the cast stands front-on with the same open mouth and stiff arms in s1, s3, s10 to s14, with the lineworker on the camera heads in s4
